shortDescription: Manages networks on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the network is related to.

options.name: acl
options.description: The name of the access control list for the VPC network tier.

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Access control type for the network. If not specified, Cloudstack will default to C(account) for isolated networks and C(domain) for shared networks. Only considered on create.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cidr_ipv6
options.description: CIDR of IPv6 network, must be at least /64. Only considered on create.

options.name: clean_up
options.description: Cleanup old network elements. Only considered on I(state=restarted).

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the network. If not specified, I(name) will be used as I(display_text).

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the network is related to.

options.name: end_ip
options.description: The ending IPv4 address of the network belongs to. If not specified, value of I(start_ip) is used. Only considered on create.

options.name: end_ipv6
options.description: The ending IPv6 address of the network belongs to. If not specified, value of I(start_ipv6) is used. Only considered on create.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway of the network. Required for shared networks and isolated networks when it belongs to a VPC. Only considered on create.

options.name: gateway_ipv6
options.description: The gateway of the IPv6 network. Required for shared networks. Only considered on create.

options.name: isolated_pvlan
options.description: The isolated private VLAN for this network.

options.name: name
options.description: Name (case sensitive) of the network.

options.name: netmask
options.description: The netmask of the network. Required for shared networks and isolated networks when it belongs to a VPC. Only considered on create.

options.name: network_domain
options.description: The network domain.

options.name: network_offering
options.description: Name of the offering for the network. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the network to be deployed in.

options.name: start_ip
options.description: The beginning IPv4 address of the network belongs to. Only considered on create.

options.name: start_ipv6
options.description: The beginning IPv6 address of the network belongs to. Only considered on create.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the network.

options.name: subdomain_access
options.description: Defines whether to allow subdomains to use networks dedicated to their parent domain(s). Should be used with I(acl_type=domain). Only considered on create.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: The ID or VID of the network.

options.name: vpc
options.description: Name of the VPC of the network.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the network should be deployed.
